dimensions.assessment: Affects participants in the VA Health Professionals Scholarship Program and individuals visiting or working in Veterans Health Administration facilities.
dimensions.evidence: No person (including any veteran, patient, resident, employee of the Department, contractor, or visitor) may smoke

dimensions.assessment: Ensures timely job placement for specific healthcare trainees and completely prohibits smoking on VHA facility premises.
dimensions.evidence: No person... may smoke on the premises of any facility of the Veterans Health Administration.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes operational adjustments for VA employment contracts and smoking enforcement without specifying new major appropriations.
Amends title 38 to add specific hiring deadlines for scholarship recipients and updates facility rules regarding smoking.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall ensure that a participant in the Scholarship Program receives a contract for employment... by not later than 90 days

dimensions.assessment: Enforces a permanent smoking prohibition and requires scholarship implementation reports through September 30, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: The termination date specified in this paragraph is September 30, 2027.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates timely VA employment contracts for scholarship participants through FY2027 and institutes a total smoking ban across all Veterans Health Administration facilities.
